prompt: Hibernate Search MassIndexer MySQL JDBC idFetchSize value
answer:
For MySQL, set the MassIndexer’s `idFetchSize` to `Integer.MIN_VALUE`:

```java
fullTextEntityManager.createIndexer(MyEntity.class)
    .idFetchSize(Integer.MIN_VALUE)
    .startAndWait();
```

This prevents the MySQL JDBC driver from preloading the entire primary-key result set into memory.
